---
name: Scoped change or bug
about: A focused problem with testable acceptance criteria
---

## Problem
What happens, what should happen, and how can it be reproduced? Separate evidence
from suspected causes; omit credentials and personal data.

## Scope and acceptance criteria
- [ ] Observable outcome

## Risks and dependencies
Affected repository/component; security/API/migration impact; linked parent spec,
companion issue/PR and any required order. Use one specification owner across repos.

## Verification
Required automated checks and concise staging/device cases, or why not applicable.

## Boundaries
Out of scope; merge/deployment authorization, if any. An implementation request
alone does not authorize merge or deployment.
